translations.web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
translations.bsb: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
translations.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
translations.asv: I came to cast fire upon the earth; and what do I desire, if it is already kindled?
